---
title: "What is the geometry of the fully optimized 5 mm glider?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 50.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 35.0    # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 130.0     # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 29.7     # s the probe actually used

from IPython.display import Markdown

opt = optimize_full_glider(verbose=False)
sol = opt['sol']

c_root = sol.value(opt['c_root']) * 1000
taper = sol.value(opt['taper'])
sweep = sol.value(opt['sweep'])
dihedral = sol.value(opt['dihedral'])

h_span = sol.value(opt['h_span']) * 1000
h_chord = sol.value(opt['h_chord']) * 1000
h_inc = sol.value(opt['h_inc'])

v_span = sol.value(opt['v_span']) * 1000
v_chord = sol.value(opt['v_chord']) * 1000

boom_len = sol.value(opt['boom_len']) * 1000
cg_x = sol.value(opt['cg_x']) * 1000

md = f"""
| Component | Span / Length | Chord / Taper | Angle |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Wing** | 300 mm | $c_{{\\text{{root}}}}$ {c_root:.1f} mm, $\\lambda$ {taper:.2f} | Sweep {sweep:.1f}°, Dihedral {dihedral:.1f}° |
| **H-stab** | {h_span:.1f} mm | {h_chord:.1f} mm | Incidence {h_inc:.1f}° |
| **V-stab** | {v_span:.1f} mm | {v_chord:.1f} mm | - |
| **Fuselage** | Boom {boom_len:.1f} mm | CG $x$ {cg_x:.1f} mm | - |
"""
```

**Answer.** The optimizer converges on a forward-swept wing (sweep [`{python} f"{sweep:.1f}"`]°) with strong taper ([`{python} f"{taper:.2f}"`]) and moderate dihedral ([`{python} f"{dihedral:.1f}"`]°). The horizontal tail acts as a lifting surface with a relatively large negative incidence ([`{python} f"{h_inc:.1f}"`]°) to offset the pitching moment of the forward-swept wing, and the boom is [`{python} f"{boom_len:.1f}"`] mm long.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
display(Markdown(md))
footer(optimize_full_glider)
```
